locations.note: Six cases in 1894 and 1895, from a harpooned sailor to a vanished train, with moral choices at the end of each.
Every case starts and ends in the rooms at 221B, where the harpoon from the Black Peter case hangs on the wall.
Blood Bath: an archaeologist found dead in the locked steam room of the Roman Baths off the Strand.
The Kew Gardens Drama: an old friend asks Holmes to look into the theft of exotic plants from Kew.
